items.control_name: Prohibit Ingress from Internet on RDP (3389) and SSH (22)
items.description: NSG inbound security rules must deny 0.0.0.0/0 on RDP and SSH ports.
items.current_value: NSG 'nsg-prod-app' denies all internet management traffic
items.recommended_value: 0 NSGs allow unrestricted Internet access on ports 22/3389
items.remediation_notes: Use Azure Bastion for remote administrative VM access.

items.control_name: Enforce Azure Firewall Premium with IDPS and TLS Inspection
items.description: Hub-and-spoke VNet architectures must route egress/ingress traffic through Azure Firewall Premium with IDPS enabled in Alert & Deny mode.
items.current_value: Azure Firewall Standard deployed without IDPS
items.recommended_value: Azure Firewall Premium with IDPS Mode = 'AlertAndDeny'
items.remediation_notes: Upgrade Azure Firewall SKU from Standard to Premium and configure IDPS signatures.

items.control_name: Enable Azure DDoS Protection Standard on Production Virtual Networks
items.description: Production VNets hosting internet-facing endpoints must be enrolled in Azure DDoS Protection Standard.
items.recommended_value: DDoS Standard protection plan attached to all public VNets
items.remediation_notes: Review DDoS alert telemetry in Azure Monitor log workspace.

items.control_name: Enable WAF in Prevention Mode on Application Gateway / Front Door
items.description: Application Gateways and Front Door endpoints must execute WAF in Prevention mode with OWASP Core Rule Set 3.2+.
items.current_value: App Gateway WAF in Prevention mode with CRS 3.2
items.recommended_value: WAF = Prevention mode across 100% of public HTTP/HTTPS listeners
items.remediation_notes: Regularly review WAF firewall logs for false positives and custom exclusion rules.
